stories.title: Éviction de Charles Sapin : pourquoi France Inter a cédé aux syndicats

en.title: Removal of Charles Sapin: why France Inter gave in to unions
en.summary: Charles Sapin was offered participation in a debate instead of an editorial slot, which he declined. He criticized France Inter's management for capitulating to union pressure.

stories.title: «Théâtre antifasciste», «exercice de victimisation» : après la suppression de l’édito de Charles Sapin sur France Inter, la gauche exulte, la droite dénonce une atteinte au pluralisme

en.title: "Antifascist theater", "victimization exercise": after the removal of Charles Sapin's editorial from France Inter, the left celebrates, the right denounces an attack on pluralism
en.summary: The removal of Charles Sapin's editorial from France Inter sparked opposing reactions, with right-wing figures criticizing misuse of taxpayer funds while left-wing officials hailed it as a victory for radio staff following mobilization.

stories.title: Arabie saoudite : la coalition militaire accuse les houthistes d’avoir lancé un missile balistique sur Riyad

en.title: Saudi Arabia: the military coalition accuses Houthis of launching a ballistic missile on Riyadh
en.summary: A military coalition reported that Houthi fighters launched a ballistic missile at Riyadh, with explosions heard in the Saudi capital for the first time amid ongoing regional tensions.

stories.title: Stéphane Azihari : «L’affaire Sapin prouve que France Inter est déjà privatisée… par la gauche sectaire»

en.title: Stéphane Azihari: "The Sapin affair proves that France Inter is already privatized... by sectarian left"
en.summary: A commentary criticizes France Inter's removal of an editorial, arguing it demonstrates the broadcaster's inability to enforce legal obligations required of a public service accessible to all citizens.

stories.title: Des "perturbations majeures" ont affecté l'aéroport de Riyad, après des explosions entendues dans la capitale de l'Arabie saoudite

en.title: "Major disruptions" affected Riyadh airport after explosions heard in Saudi Arabia's capital
en.summary: Explosions struck Riyadh causing significant airport disruptions, with Iran-aligned Houthi fighters later claiming responsibility for attacks on sensitive sites and Aramco installations in the capital.

stories.title: Radio France : la chronique de Charles Sapin sur France Inter enterrée, les syndicats renoncent à la grève

en.title: Radio France: Charles Sapin's column on France Inter cancelled, unions abandon strike
en.summary: Charles Sapin's column is being removed from France Inter's schedule after the refusal to convert his editorial into a debate format. Trade unions have withdrawn their planned strike action for Monday.

stories.title: Accord sur le Groenland : «Pour les Etats-Unis, c’est une reculade significative par rapport aux objectifs fixés par Trump»

en.title: Greenland agreement: "For the United States, it's a significant retreat from Trump's stated objectives"
en.summary: A geopolitics expert argues that the agreement announced by the U.S. president actually represents a rebalancing of power relations that disadvantages Washington relative to Denmark and Greenland.

stories.title: France Inter supprime l'édito contesté de Charles Sapin qui déplore "une censure préventive"

en.title: France Inter removes Charles Sapin's contested editorial, which he describes as "preventive censorship"
en.summary: Charles Sapin, a journalist and deputy director of the conservative magazine Valeurs actuelles, announced the cancellation of his weekly editorial on France Inter following protests and strikes over his publication's alleged far-right ideology.

stories.title: Charles Sapin renonce à intervenir sur France Inter après la suppression de son édito du dimanche matin par la direction de la radio publique

en.title: Charles Sapin declines to appear on France Inter after removal of his Sunday morning editorial by public radio management
en.summary: Charles Sapin, deputy director of Valeurs actuelles, declined further participation at France Inter after the station's management cancelled his regular editorial segment and proposed a debate format instead.

stories.title: Présence militaire renforcée, Chine et Russie ciblées… Ce que l'on sait de l'accord de sécurité sur le Groenland annoncé par Donald Trump

en.title: Reinforced military presence, China and Russia targeted... What is known about the security agreement on Greenland announced by Donald Trump
en.summary: The U.S. president announced a historic agreement with Denmark regarding Greenland, intended to prevent American adversaries from establishing military presence on the autonomous territory. The agreement is scheduled for signing the following week.

stories.title: Trump annonce un accord avec le Danemark sur le Groenland

en.title: Trump announces agreement with Denmark on Greenland
en.summary: President Trump announced a historic agreement granting the United States responsibility for defending Danish territory. The accord formalized American military presence, which had been maintained under treaties since World War II.

stories.title: Carburant, budget, dette et guerres : le temps des périls. L’édito de Bruno Jeudy

en.title: Fuel, budget, debt and wars: a time of perils. Editorial by Bruno Jeudy
en.summary: Editorial by Bruno Jeudy, deputy director of La Tribune Dimanche, addressing major economic and geopolitical challenges.

stories.title: « Bon courage à ceux qui essaient de me dépeindre en cryptomacroniste » : pour Glucksmann, l’heure de la riposte

en.title: "Good luck to those trying to portray me as a crypto-Macronist": for Glucksmann, it's time to strike back
en.summary: A European Parliament member responded to primary opponents' attacks ahead of a debate scheduled for September 23.

stories.title: « On demande un petit effort à tout le monde » : les APL seront bien gelées l’année prochaine, confirme le ministre Vincent Jeanbrun

en.title: "We are asking for a small effort from everyone": housing subsidies will indeed be frozen next year, confirms Minister Vincent Jeanbrun
en.summary: France's Housing Minister confirmed on September 19 that housing assistance payments will be frozen in the coming year, a measure previously announced earlier that month.

stories.title: « Il est possible qu’un jour, nous devions partir » : les attaques de drones à la frontière avec l'Ukraine inquiètent Varsovie

en.title: "It is possible that one day we will have to leave": Russian drone attacks at the Ukrainian border worry Warsaw
en.summary: Poland expresses concern after recent Russian drone strikes hit border areas with Ukraine, fearing potential attacks on Polish territory.

stories.title: David Amiel, ministre de l’Action et des comptes publics : « Ce que nous proposons est l’inverse d’un budget électoraliste »

en.title: David Amiel, Minister of Action and Public Accounts: "What we are proposing is the opposite of an electoral budget"
en.summary: A minister close to Emmanuel Macron called on parliamentarians to prioritize protecting public finances in relation to the presidency.
